sessions.phase_label: Initial revision proposal and writing assessment
Full manuscript scope and deliverable clarification
Manuscript access, revision work, and chapter submission

requirements.title: Existing Question Set Curation
requirements.definition: Review the complete existing set of approximately 250 questions and recommend removal of outdated or duplicate questions and restructuring, combination, or elimination of question categories where appropriate.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers selection and organization of the existing question inventory; creation or rewording of current questions and development of answer content are independently reviewable behaviors.

requirements.title: Question Content Modernization
requirements.definition: Add, replace, or reword questions so the second edition reflects contemporary leadership interviews and present-day workplace practices.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers modernization of question wording and coverage, separate from deciding which existing questions or categories remain in the book.

requirements.title: Layered Answer Structure
requirements.definition: Provide structured answer guidance for retained and newly added questions, including mandatory framing guidance with integrated answer frameworks and a sample answer, with interviewer intent and common mistakes included where useful.
requirements.boundary_note: The answer layers and embedded frameworks form one presentation mechanism; individual layers are attributes rather than separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Leadership Pre-Interview Preparation Chapter
requirements.definition: Add a concise pre-interview preparation chapter or checklist focused on preparation relevant to experienced professionals and leadership-level interviews rather than generic fundamentals.
requirements.boundary_note: This chapter has its own subject matter and acceptance criteria and can be revised independently of the other four chapters.

requirements.title: AI Interview Preparation Chapter
requirements.definition: Add a concise chapter explaining how readers can use AI prompts, techniques, and tools for interview preparation.
requirements.boundary_note: The client explicitly identifies this chapter as mandatory and distinctive, giving it an independent lifecycle from the other new chapters.

requirements.title: Questions Candidates Can Ask Interviewers Chapter
requirements.definition: Add a question-and-answer chapter covering effective questions leadership candidates can ask an interviewer.
requirements.boundary_note: This is an independently deliverable question-and-answer chapter with content distinct from preparation, AI, first-time leadership, and remote or hybrid leadership.

requirements.title: First-Time Leader Questions Chapter
requirements.definition: Add a question-and-answer chapter specifically addressing people interviewing for their first leadership role.
requirements.boundary_note: The chapter serves a distinct reader transition and can be developed or evaluated independently of the other new chapters.

requirements.title: Remote and Hybrid Leadership Questions Chapter
requirements.definition: Add a question-and-answer chapter covering interviews for remote and hybrid leadership roles.
requirements.boundary_note: Remote and hybrid leadership has distinct questions and acceptance criteria and should not be merged with the other chapter topics.

requirements.title: Integrated Global Interview Perspective
requirements.definition: Integrate country and market differences organically throughout the planned material, supported by a short introductory note describing the principal US and India audience and relevant observations about additional markets.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a cross-cutting content behavior rather than a separate location chapter; country examples are attributes of the integrated perspective.

requirements.title: Hybrid Companion Resource Package
requirements.definition: Create online companion resources that provide practical and visual learning alongside the book, with most selected resources delivered as finished assets, video concepts supplied as scripts, and templates prepared sufficiently for production.
requirements.boundary_note: The specific resource list remains flexible, so checklists, prompts, videos, mock interviews, templates, and resume tips are candidate contents and delivery-mode attributes of one companion package rather than confirmed independent deliverables.

requirements.title: Second-Edition Manuscript Word Budget
requirements.definition: Keep the completed book within its overall 50,000-word limit while planning revised and added material around the approximately 37,000-word first-edition baseline and the corrected 13,000-word available project allocation.
requirements.boundary_note: The baseline, revision allocation, chapter planning ranges, and final maximum are coupled attributes of one manuscript word-budget constraint.

requirements.title: Target Reader and Quick-Reference Alignment
requirements.definition: Ensure the revised book remains a practical quick-reference interview-preparation guide suitable for experienced managers, team leads, senior professionals, and people entering leadership roles for the first time.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a book-wide audience and usability constraint; chapter-specific topics remain separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Tracked Manuscript Editing and Rationale
requirements.definition: Make manuscript revisions in the designated Google Doc using suggestion mode and leave useful comments, including a brief rationale for every recommended question deletion.
requirements.boundary_note: This Requirement concerns the independently required review artifact and traceability of edits, not the semantic decision about which questions should remain.

requirements.title: Editorial Approval Before Content Changes
requirements.definition: Treat proposed question or category additions, removals, and other author-suggested revisions as recommendations requiring editorial-team review before implementation in the approved manuscript.
requirements.boundary_note: Approval gating is distinct from recording edits in suggestion mode because a properly tracked recommendation may still lack authorization for final implementation.

requirements.title: Original Authorship and Limited AI Assistance
requirements.definition: Ensure the submitted manuscript represents the author's original work and professional judgment, with AI-assisted tools limited to permitted support functions such as spelling, grammar, research, outlining, translation, and editorial assistance.
requirements.boundary_note: This is an independently enforceable provenance and authorship constraint; the final message reports it as an existing contractual acceptance condition rather than merely expressing a general preference.

requirements.title: Reader-Facing Manuscript Cleanliness
requirements.definition: Ensure submitted reader-facing content does not contain internal prompts, workflow scaffolding, or direct editing instructions that are not intended to appear in the book.
requirements.boundary_note: The presence of internal instructional scaffolding is independently testable and can fail even when the manuscript's authorship and factual references are otherwise acceptable.

requirements.title: Manuscript Reference Completeness
requirements.definition: Ensure that manuscript references to notes, sections, or other book content correspond to content that actually exists in the submitted document.
requirements.boundary_note: This requirement is limited to internal reference integrity and is separate from originality and removal of workflow scaffolding.

unresolved_candidates.description: Company-specific matrix answers appear in the initial proposal but are absent from the later restated scope; Event extraction should determine whether this was an observable removal or merely an unfinalized option.

The hybrid companion-resource package is required, but the exact asset list and quantities remain flexible; the examples should not be converted into separate mandatory Requirements without further evidence.
